admission.justification: Together the two members guarantee both bare Pyrefly termination over tracked files including .dagger/ without scanning nested environments/caches and zero [tool.pyrefly] project-excludes drops on explicit --force-exclude file-list runs, which neither member promises alone.

guarantee: Root [tool.pyrefly] sets project-includes = [".", ".dagger"] and disable-project-excludes-heuristics = true while project-excludes skips virtual environments, dependency trees, build outputs, and tool caches at any depth without matching any tracked Python file (including .dagger/), so bare Pyrefly runs finish without scanning nested environments or caches and explicit --force-exclude file-list runs in .githooks/_gate.sh and quality_plan.py check the complete tracked Python population with zero silent drops.
title: Bare and file-list Pyrefly runs keep excludes disjoint from tracked Python
